global_guardrails: Preregister predictors and evaluation rules before future outcome load.
Do not convert missing historical evidence to zero.
Do not relax eligibility or review rules to meet cohort-size targets.
Stop infeasible designs before outcome load rather than tune after results.
Keep raw exchange/XBRL/PDF evidence out of public workflow artifacts.
Automated documentary page candidates are not scores until the frozen relation/review gate approves them.
One holdout cannot mutate official RK-MIS pillar weights.
